pros.description: Staff: Friendly team assist with luggage, tour bookings, and local recommendations.
Location: Quiet position on a side street near the river and walking areas.
Breakfast: Freshly cooked meals feature banana pancakes and Vietnamese coffee.

cons.description: Room Space: Deluxe options are spacious, but standard units feel small with limited storage.

hostInfo.name: Vinh Nguyen
hostInfo.welcomeMessage: Welcome to Hue Glory Legacy Homestay, formerly known as Hue Sweethouse 1. Our homestay offers comfortable rooms in the heart of Hue.
hostInfo.ownerInfo: Hello! We are the hosts of Hue Glory Legacy. We enjoy meeting travelers from all over the world and sharing local tips about Hue. Our goal is to create a comfortable, clean and relaxing place where guests can feel at home during their stay. We are always happy to help with recommendations for food, sightseeing and transportation so that you can enjoy the best experience in Hue.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo: Hue Glory Legacy is located in a quiet and convenient area of Hue city. Guests can easily explore many famous attractions such as the Imperial City, Trang Tien Bridge and the Perfume River. There are also many local restaurants, cafes and street food nearby where you can enjoy authentic Hue cuisine. The area is peaceful but still close to the city center, making it a perfect place to relax after a day of sightseeing.

Located just 1km from Dong Ba Market Jade Hotel offers accommodation in Thua Thien, Hue. Guests can enjoy a meal at the on-site restaurant, or simply lounge at the sun terrace.

All rooms are fitted with a TV for entertainment, and are fitted with a private bathroom with a bath or shower, with slippers and free toiletries provided. This accommodation features free WiFi and private parking.

There is a 24-hour front desk at the property.

The hotel also offers bike hire and car hire. Trang Tien Bridge is 1 km from Jade Hotel, while Chieu Ung Pagoda is 1.8 km from the property.
